title: Story Innovation Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners reinvent a standard "we cut costs 20%" story by choosing an unconventional structure, angle, format, and example, and see the resulting story concept.

learningObjectives: Innovate a new storytelling approach by selecting unconventional story elements (structure, angle, format, example) that differentiate from standard approaches.
prerequisites: Story Innovation and Story Differentiation sections of Chapter 13

keyQuestions: Innovate a new storytelling approach by selecting unconventional story elements (structure, angle, format, example) that differentiate from standard approaches.
assessmentOpportunities: A concept that is differentiated on all four dimensions.
Learner can explain why innovation must serve the insight, not just change the format.
